description: Classify a PDF as text-based, scanned, image-based or mixed, and report which pages need OCR and why. Samples content streams rather than extracting text, so it answers in tens of milliseconds. Call this before any other pdf function.

FsScope.description:
The filesystem jail a call runs under.

The harness stamps this onto every function it dispatches, so a `path` an agent supplies has to be checked against it. Without the check these functions would read any document on the machine and hand back its text, which is a way around the scope the session was granted. Mirrors the shape the shell worker takes.

grants.description: Additional directories or files explicitly granted to this session.

request_schema.description: Where the PDF comes from. Exactly one of the two fields must be set.

bytes_base64.description: Base64-encoded PDF bytes, for a document with no path. Mutually exclusive with `path`.

fs_scope.description: The filesystem jail this call runs under. Stamped by the harness on an agent's call; absent on an operator or console call, which is already user-initiated and not subject to the agent's scope.

password.description: Password for an encrypted document. Never logged or echoed back.

path.description: Filesystem path to the PDF. Mutually exclusive with `bytes_base64`.

sample_pages.description: Pages sampled for the verdict, overriding the configured default. `0` scans every page, which is slower but settles a borderline mixed document.

request_schema.title: Request

DocumentType.description: What a document is made of.

oneOf.description: Pictures of pages. Every page needs OCR.
Images with little or no text layer.
Some pages carry text, others do not. Read `pages_needing_ocr`.

PageOcrReason.description: Why one page cannot be read without OCR.

reasons.description: Machine-readable reasons: `scanned` (a raster page), `no_text` (nothing extractable and nothing to OCR), `vector_text` (characters drawn as outlines rather than text) or `suspected_garbled_text` (a text layer that decodes to nonsense).

confidence.description: How much to trust the verdict, from 0.0 to 1.0.

has_encoding_issues.description: `true` when font encodings decoded badly. Only known on the encrypted path, which extracts far enough to notice; absent otherwise, where `suspected_garbled_text` in `ocr_reasons` carries the same signal.

ocr_recommended.description: `true` when the images carry meaning the text layer does not, so OCR adds something even on a text-based document. Absent for an encrypted document, for the same reason as `pages_sampled`.

pages_needing_ocr.description: 1-indexed pages that cannot be read without OCR. Empty for a clean text-based document.

pages_sampled.description: Pages actually inspected. Lower than `page_count` when sampling, so a verdict from a sample can be told apart from one that read everything. Absent for an encrypted document, which takes a decryption path that does not report the counters.

pages_with_text.description: Inspected pages that carry text operators. Absent for an encrypted document, for the same reason as `pages_sampled`.

source.description: Source label: the file name, or `<inline>` for an in-memory document.

title.description: Document title from the PDF metadata, when it has one.
